traits.woodiness.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 3 (1914), Fuchsia (genus account), p. 1299 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): shrubs and small trees; Bean (vol. 1 p. 576): shrubs, in mild places trees 10 ft or more high.

traits.inflorescence.note: Bean, Trees and Shrubs Hardy in the British Isles vol. 1 (1914), Fuchsia, p. 577 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): the flowers pendulous, produced singly on their stalks from the leaf-axils.

traits.flower_posture.note: Bean, Trees and Shrubs Hardy in the British Isles vol. 1 (1914), Fuchsia, p. 577 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): the flowers pendulous; Bailey (p. 1299): flowers usually drooping.

traits.flower_merosity.note: Hooker, Handbook of the New Zealand Flora (1864-67), Fuchsia (genus account), p. 75 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): calyx tube with 4 lobes, petals 4, stamens 8, ovary 4-celled.

traits.stamens.note: Hooker, Handbook of the New Zealand Flora (1864-67), Fuchsia (genus account), p. 75 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): stamens 8; Bean (p. 577): 8.

traits.carpels.note: Hooker, Handbook of the New Zealand Flora (1864-67), Fuchsia (genus account), p. 75 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): ovary 4-celled; Bailey (p. 1299): a 4-loculed berry.

traits.hypanthium.note: Hooker, Handbook of the New Zealand Flora (1864-67), Fuchsia (genus account), p. 75 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): the calyx tube adherent to the ovary and produced beyond it, the petals inserted at its throat.

traits.fruit_type.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 3 (1914), Fuchsia (genus account), p. 1299 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): the fruit a soft 4-loculed berry; Bean (p. 577): a juicy berry.

traits.calyx_in_fruit.note: Hooker, Handbook of the New Zealand Flora (1864-67), Fuchsia (genus account), p. 75 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): the calyx limb deciduous, falling above the ovary and leaving a scar on the berry.

traits.fruit_posture.note: Kirk, The Forest Flora of New Zealand (1889), Fuchsia excorticata, p. 55 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): a pendulous berry; the berries of F. magellanica hang on their stalks in photographs (iNaturalist 43195696).
